description: Defines classes and data structures for managing fence timing, including FenceTime, FenceTimeline, and FenceToFenceTimeMap, used for synchronization and testing within Android graphics framework.

classes.name: FenceTime
classes.description: Represents a wrapper around a fence that provides thread-safe access to its validity and signal time.

classes.name: FenceTime::Snapshot
classes.description: An atomic, flattenable snapshot of FenceTime's state, including fence and signal time.

classes.name: FenceTimeline
classes.description: A FIFO queue of FenceTime objects to track fences expected to signal.

classes.name: FenceToFenceTimeMap
classes.description: A test utility class that maps fences to FenceTime objects, allowing simulation of fence signaling.

methods.name: applyTrustedSnapshot
methods.description: Replaces the FenceTime's state with a trusted snapshot.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the FenceTime is valid.

methods.name: getSignalTime
methods.description: Retrieves the fence's signal timestamp, querying the fence if necessary.

methods.name: getCachedSignalTime
methods.description: Returns the cached signal timestamp without querying the fence.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a current snapshot of the FenceTime.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the fence to signal up to a specified timeout.

methods.name: signalForTest
methods.description: Simulates signaling the fence for testing purposes.

methods.name: createFenceTimeForTest
methods.description: Creates a FenceTime for testing, wrapping a given Fence.

methods.name: signalAllForTest
methods.description: Signals all FenceTimes associated with a given Fence for testing.
